pr_title: br: add table filter for log restore
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #57613

Problem Summary:
Need table filter for PiTR

### What changed and how does it work?
The following happens if a custom filter is specified during PiTR.

1. Do a log backup meta scan at first before snapshot restore, and record all the table rename history and table mapping information during the scan, since we don't have access to genGlobalId, we use a temp id as a placeholder.
3. During snapshot restore, adjust the tables that need to be restored according to the rename history. It needs to add tables that renamed into the filter and removes the tables that are renamed out of the filter range during log backup. And put all the tables that need to be restored into a map/filter and pass down to log restore
4. During log restore, we use that map/filter from the above and filters out the tables/kvs that don't need to restore/rewrite, and we replace the temp id in the id map with real global ids. 
5. For actual meta kv restore, use id map to filter out the kvs that doesn't need to restore. so for tables not exist in the id map, we can simply ignore it because they are filtered out.
6. The id map is persisted once built to work with checkpoint, so our filter naturally works with checkpoint as well.  

Performance:
we are still scanning log meta kv twice, it's just we move the previously id map building step before snapshot happens.

issue_context.title: br: add table filter for Pitr restore
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

Right now only snapshot backup/restore supports filter, users are asking for Pitr to support it. We only need to add filter for log restore but not backup

Need to consider table rename corner cases
1. table renamed into the filter during log replay should be kept after restore
2. table renamed out of filter range during log replay should be dropped after restore
3. Should naturally works with insertGCRow, repairIndex and TiFlash

### Tasks:
  - [x] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/58112 
  - [x] https://github.com/pingcap/kvproto/pull/1294
  - [x] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/57394
  - [x] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/59683
  - [x] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/59678
  - [ ] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/59359
  - [ ] https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/59281 (depends on https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/59009)

review_comments: maybe forget to replace the codes by the function.
great observation! did rebase twice and a lot of conflicts, forgot to use the function
oh it's indexed differently if you mean to clone `rc.databases`. one is indexed by db name and this one is db id
Should we handle the `DELETE` operations in the write CF? (Which doesn't have a value.)

right, I think it's not necessarily needed, we are only tracking the all the table ids at this step, if there is a delete there must be a create table happened before, so that should be tracked already.
oh I think you mean we can optimize by not restoring if deleted? right now we track it but it will be dropped during log backup, so less optimal but does not impact correctness.
`tempIDs[i] > tempIDs[j]` does not means `upstream(tempIDs[i]) > upstream[tempIDs[j])`, so is it necessary to sort tempIDs?

yes it doesn't, I was thinking to assign id based on first seen first, somewhat like sorted by time in the log backup, I was hoping it can be a bit useful when debugging. The order doesn't suggest anything such as upstream id ordering.
